lines.en: {i}This{/i} is what you get for bathing in indecision while everyone else drowned themselves in the fountain of youth.
lines.zh: {i}这{/i}就是你泡在犹豫不决里、而别人早已把自己溺死在青春之泉中的下场。

lines.en: But that’s okay — because somewhere in the wishing well, there’s a bucket with your name on it.
lines.zh: 不过没关系——因为在许愿池的某个地方，有一只写着你名字的水桶。

lines.en: You can climb in whenever you like, but you’ll need to wait for someone or {i}something{/i} else to pull you up.
lines.zh: 你想什么时候爬进去都行，但你得等着别的什么人、或{i}什么东西{/i}把你拉上来。
要么那样……要么就许愿许得更用力些。

lines.en: There is no room for second guesses here.
lines.zh: 这里容不下事后的反复揣测。
所以他才「受」那么多苦。
: 你手机呢？
: Rin——
: 在桌子上……

lines.en: : Can you at least text Sensei and tell him that you’re taking it away, though? If he tries to contact me-
lines.zh: : 那你能不能至少给 Sensei 发条短信，说你要把它没收？要是他试着联系我——

lines.en: : I have his phone, remember? I’ll tell him when I go back to the bar.
lines.zh: : 我记得他的手机在我这儿？我回酒吧的时候会跟他说的。

lines.en: : Wait, Rin I understand. But why do you have {i}Sensei’s{/i} phone?
lines.zh: : 等等，Rin 我明白了。可你为什么会有 {i}Sensei 的{/i}手机？
: 再说一遍，你可以问 Rin。

lines.en: : Don’t stick around for long, though. She’s grounded indefinitely starting right now.
lines.zh: : 不过别待太久。从现在起她被无限期禁足了。

lines.en: : Oh...yeah. I had some stuff to do tonight anyway.
lines.zh: : 哦……好。反正我今晚也有事要做。
: 嗯……行吧。

lines.en: : Do I need to take your laptop too?
lines.zh: : 我还需要把你的笔记本电脑也收走吗？

lines.en: : Please don’t. I need that for school.
lines.zh: : 求你别。我上学要用。

lines.en: : You know I have to tell Rie about this, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道我得把这件事告诉 Rie 吧？
: 知道，妈……我知道。
: 好吧……
: 晚安。

lines.en: : What the fuck was that about? I’ve never seen your mom look so serious before.
lines.zh: : 刚才那到底是怎么回事？我从没见过你妈表情那么严肃。
: 对不起……
: 对不起什么？什么——

lines.en: : I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry! I tried to hold it in, but I couldn’t! I really tried, Chika! I’m so sorry!
lines.zh: : 对不起，对不起，对不起，对不起！我努力想憋住的，可我憋不住！我真的努力了，Chika！我真的很抱歉！
: 憋住……什么？发生什么事了？

lines.en: : If I tell you...you’ll never want to talk to me again. I’m scared. I don’t...want you to leave.
lines.zh: : 要是我说了……你就再也不想理我了。我害怕。我不……想让你走。

lines.en: : Just calm down, okay? I’m not going to leave you, Rin. I can assure you I’ve gone through worse than whatever it is you’re about to tell me.
lines.zh: : 先冷静下来，好吗？我不会离开你的，Rin。我可以向你保证，不管你要说什么，我都经历过比那更糟的事。

lines.en: : That...doesn’t change how you’re never going to look at me the same way again. And I’ll deserve it, too. You trusted me and...and you shouldn’t have. You-
lines.zh: : 那……也改变不了一个事实：你再也不会用同样的眼光看我了。而且我也活该。你信任我，可……可你不该信任我。你——

lines.en: : I...it...I’m...I’m so fucking sorry, Chika! I {i}really{/i} am! I’m just lonely! And confused! And I’m sorry! I’m really, really fucking-
lines.zh: : 我……那……我……我真的他妈很抱歉，Chika！{i}真的{/i}！我只是太孤独了！又很困惑！对不起！我真的、真的他妈——

lines.en: : Wow. You are a {i}wreck{/i} right now. Whatever it is must be pretty bad, huh?
lines.zh: : 哇。你现在真是{i}一团糟{/i}。看来那件事相当严重吧？
: Chika……我——

lines.en: : When I was little, my mom used to hold my hand whenever she’d have to give me bad news.
lines.zh: : 我小的时候，每次我妈要告诉我坏消息，都会先握住我的手。

lines.en: : It just makes it hurt a little less. And reminds you that there’s someone else you get to experience that pain {i}with.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那样会让它没那么疼。也提醒你，还有另一个人{i}和你一起{/i}承受这份痛苦。

lines.en: : But...I...I’m the one causing it. You’ll want to break my hand off.
lines.zh: : 可……我……我就是那个带来痛苦的人。你会想把我的手掰断的。
: 试试看啊。
: Chika——

lines.en: : Just shut up and hold my hand, Rokuhara. Dry those tears too. You’re terrible at delivering bad news.
lines.zh: : 闭上嘴，握住我的手，Rokuhara。眼泪也擦擦。你传达坏消息的本事真是烂透了。

lines.en: : It feels weird...hearing you call me by my last name.
lines.zh: : 感觉好奇怪……听你叫我的姓。

lines.en: : Will it feel a little less weird if you use mine too?
lines.zh: : 要是你也叫我姓，会不会就没那么奇怪了？
: Cho……
: Choso……kabe……
: 奇怪吗？
: 有一点。
: Rokuhara。
: ……Chosokabe。
: Rokuhara……
: Chosokabe？……
: 噗！是啊……{i}确实{/i}挺奇怪的，不是吗？

lines.en: : Come on. I feel like I’m gonna want to sit down for this.
lines.zh: : 走吧。我感觉我待会儿会想坐下听。
: 嗯……我觉得你可能……
: 那么……

lines.en: : The reason...my mom took my phone away...is...
lines.zh: : 我妈……没收我手机的原因……是……
: 我该怎么……从哪儿……

lines.en: : Take your time. I was lying when I told your mom I had stuff to do tonight.
lines.zh: : 慢慢来。我跟你妈说今晚有事，那是骗她的。
: 嗯……我也对她撒了谎……
: 关于……基本上所有事……

lines.en: : So this is all one big misunderstanding then?
lines.zh: : 所以这一切都是一场巨大的误会咯？
: 是……是啊！误会。就是……就是这样……
: 不是。
: Chika，我……

lines.en: : I think I have feelings for Sensei.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我对 Sensei 有感情。

lines.en: : And I...may have been...a little too forward about some of those feelings tonight.
lines.zh: : 而我……今晚可能对其中一部分感情……表现得太过主动了。

lines.en: : He never...received them, though. I guess my mom...had his phone for some reason? I don’t...really get {i}why?{/i} But I sent him a bunch of texts about it and...{i}she{/i} just showed up instead.
lines.zh: : 不过他……一条都没收到。好像我妈不知为什么拿着他的手机？我也不太……明白{i}为什么{/i}？但我给他发了好多短信说这件事，结果……来的人却是{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : What kind of texts? Like...a confession?
lines.zh: : 什么样的短信？比如……告白？
: 也不……{i}全是{/i}。

lines.en: : Come on. Just be honest. We can be mature about this. I’m not going to hurt your hand.
lines.zh: : 拜托。实话实说就好。我们可以成熟地谈这件事。我又不会掰断你的手。

lines.en: : So, like...do you remember how horny you were that time Sensei started kind of avoiding you? And how you’d never shut up about all of the crazy, sexual things you wanted to do with and {i}to{/i} him once he stopped?
lines.zh: : 那……你还记得那次 Sensei 开始躲着你的时候，你有多饥渴吗？还有你没完没了地念叨，等他不再躲了，你要{i}跟他{/i}做多少疯狂的、色情的事？

lines.en: : Of course I do. It was literally hell.
lines.zh: : 当然记得。那简直是地狱。

lines.en: : Okay, well...that may or may not be how I’ve been feeling lately. And I may or may not have...sent him probably 10 paragraphs about wanting him to do me with the intensity of a western silverback.
lines.zh: : 好吧……我最近的感觉可能就是那样。而我可能……大概给他发了十段话，说想让他以西部银背大猩猩的强度来干我。
: 那个大猩猩？
: 那个大猩猩。

lines.en: : But Chika, I {i}swear,{/i} I have never actually hooked up with him. It’s all fantasy. And-
lines.zh: : 但 Chika，我{i}发誓{/i}，我从来没真的跟他发生过什么。全是幻想。而且——

lines.en: : It’s {i}not{/i} fantasy though, Rin. You literally {i}just{/i} said you have feelings for him.
lines.zh: : 可那{i}不{/i}是幻想啊，Rin。你{i}刚刚{/i}明明说了你对他有感情。

lines.en: : I do! But I’ve never acted on them for...a million reasons. And you’re one of them. One of the {i}biggest{/i} of all. I know how much you love him. And I’d never want to come between you two.
lines.zh: : 我确实有！但出于……一百万个理由，我从来没有付诸行动。而你是其中之一。是其中{i}最大{/i}的一个。我知道你有多爱他。我从来都不想夹在你们中间。

lines.en: : But if he showed up tonight...
lines.zh: : 可要是他今晚来了呢……
: 你会做吗？
: 我会的。
: 看吧？……你的手还好好的。
: 你……不生气？

lines.en: : I’m not {i}mad,{/i} no. Just a little shocked, I guess. I thought you guys were just really close friends.
lines.zh: : 我不{i}生气{/i}，不。大概只是有点震惊。我以为你们只是特别要好的朋友。

lines.en: : We {i}are.{/i} That’s the {i}biggest{/i} reason this has been fucking eating away at me. I don’t want to fuck that up, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我们{i}是{/i}啊。而这也正是这件事一直他妈啃噬我的{i}最大{/i}原因。我不想把那搞砸，Chika。

lines.en: : At the same time though, I can barely even {i}think{/i} about him without all those feelings bubbling up anymore. It’s like how I used to look at you.
lines.zh: : 可与此同时，我现在几乎只要一{i}想到{/i}他，那些感情就会翻涌上来。就像我从前看你的眼神。

lines.en: : I’m kind of sad you don’t anymore. That was really cute.
lines.zh: : 你不再那样看我了，我还有点难过。那样真的很可爱。

lines.en: : Yeah, until you broke my heart into a million pieces. Which you were well within your right to do because you never felt that way about me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，直到你把我的心碎成了一百万片。不过你完全有权利这么做，因为你从来没对我有过那种感觉。

lines.en: : So do you think it’s “love?” Or are you just {i}really{/i} horny?
lines.zh: : 那你觉得这是「爱」吗？还是你只是{i}真的{/i}很饥渴？

lines.en: : I think...I...don’t know what I think.
lines.zh: : 我觉得……我……不知道自己该怎么想。

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} love him, though. But I love {i}you{/i} too. Which is why this is so fucking hard and so fucking confusing, Chika. I don’t know what to do.
lines.zh: : 但我{i}确实{/i}爱他。我也爱{i}你{/i}。所以这件事才他妈这么难、这么他妈让人困惑，Chika。我不知道该怎么办。

lines.en: : How long have you felt this way about him?
lines.zh: : 你对他这种感觉有多久了？

lines.en: : That’s...another thing I don’t really get.
lines.zh: : 这……也是我不太明白的另一点。

lines.en: : Like...I want to say it wasn’t until after Otoha, but...maybe it was way before that? Maybe I’ve had feelings for him this entire time? I don’t know. I really don’t.
lines.zh: : 比如……我想说是在和 Otoha 分手之后，但……也许远在那之前就有了？也许我从头到尾都对他有感情？我不知道。我真的不知道。

lines.en: : Do you want to know what I think?
lines.zh: : 想知道我怎么想吗？

lines.en: : So long as you’re not thinking about how you want to cut me into pieces for sending your boyfriend a five minute video of me masturbating.
lines.zh: : 只要你没在想该怎么把我切成块，因为我给你男朋友发了段五分钟的自慰视频。

lines.en: : You sent him a video too?
lines.zh: : 你还给他发了视频？

lines.en: : Yeah! And my fucking {i}mom{/i} watched it! So that’s a thing I have to live with now!
lines.zh: : 发了！而且我他妈的{i}妈{/i}还看了！所以这件事我得带着活下去了！

lines.en: : Yeah, how’d you explain this to {i}her?{/i} She doesn’t think he’s in on it, does she?
lines.zh: : 是啊，你跟{i}她{/i}怎么解释的？她不会觉得他也有份吧？

lines.en: : I told her...mostly the truth about everything once I knew she saw the texts. But I lied to her about everything in the beginning, so I’m not sure if she believed me when I said it was all one-sided.
lines.zh: : 在她看到那些短信之后，我……基本上把所有事都照实说了。可一开始我对她撒了谎，所以我不确定她信不信我说的「全是我一厢情愿」。

lines.en: : Still, that really sucks. No phone? How are we supposed to talk while you’re at work now?
lines.zh: : 话说回来，那可真够惨的。没手机？那你在上班的时候我们要怎么聊天？

lines.en: : You still...want to talk to me? {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你……还想跟我聊天？{i}为什么？{/i}
: 因为我爱你。

lines.en: : But...wasn’t there a whole thing with Yumi before where you flipped out on her for just {i}thinking{/i} she was hooking up with Sensei? You love her way more than me and you almost killed her.
lines.zh: : 可……之前 Yumi 那件事呢？她只是{i}以为{/i}自己跟 Sensei 有一腿，你就对她大发雷霆。你爱她比爱我多得多，而你差点杀了她。

lines.en: : I love both of you equally. That thing with Yumi was a combination of a colossal misunderstanding and me not knowing everything I know today.
lines.zh: : 我对你们两个的爱是同等的。Yumi 那件事，是一场天大的误会，再加上我当时还不懂今天我所知道的这些。

lines.en: : Well, what do you know today that you didn’t know then?
lines.zh: : 那你今天知道的、当时不知道的是什么？

lines.en: : I know that love is {i}way{/i} more confusing and {i}way{/i} more complicated than it appears at first. And that’s saying a lot since it’s {i}already{/i} super intimidating.
lines.zh: : 我知道爱{i}远{/i}比它表面看起来更让人困惑、更复杂。而它本来就{i}已经{/i}够让人胆怯了，这样说可说明不少问题。

lines.en: : Well, maybe I {i}am{/i} in love with him then because confused and intimidated are definitely the most dominant emotions I’m feeling right now if you take away all the horny.
lines.zh: : 那我大概真的{i}是{/i}爱上他了吧，因为如果把所有饥渴都拿掉，困惑和胆怯绝对是我此刻最强烈的两种情绪。

lines.en: : No one takes away the horny. This is who we are now.
lines.zh: : 饥渴是拿不掉的。我们现在就是这样的人了。

lines.en: : Yeah, but {i}one{/i} of us is getting fucked with the intensity of a western silverback and the other has had to charge her vibrator like 10 times this week.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可我们其中{i}一个{/i}正被以西部银背大猩猩的强度干着，另一个这周已经给振动棒充了大概十次电。

lines.en: : What is it with you and this western silverback thing?
lines.zh: : 你跟这个西部银背大猩猩到底是怎么回事？

lines.en: : I really don’t know but I want it to stop.
lines.zh: : 我真不知道，但我希望它赶紧停下。

lines.en: : Rin, everything is going to be okay...Okay?
lines.zh: : Rin，一切都会好起来的……好吗？

lines.en: : What am I supposed to do {i}now,{/i} Chika? Wait for this to all blow over? Just sit around and hope that someone else comes along that I want {i}more?{/i}
lines.zh: : 那我{i}现在{/i}该怎么办，Chika？等着这一切风平浪静？就这么干坐着，祈祷出现另一个我{i}更{/i}想要的人？

lines.en: : Because that sounds easy, sure. But things are different with Sensei. I {i}know{/i} him. He’s not some girl I saw in middle school or a park and just decided to become obsessed with.
lines.zh: : 因为听起来很简单，是啊。可 Sensei 不一样。我{i}了解{/i}他。他不是我初中或者公园里随便看到、就决定要迷恋上的某个女孩。

lines.en: : This happened over time. And every day, it feels like it’s only getting stronger.
lines.zh: : 这是日积月累的。而且每一天，它都感觉在变得更强。
: Rin——

lines.en: : I fucking hate it, Chika! Why does it have to be {i}him?{/i} Why do I have to compete?!
lines.zh: : 我他妈恨死这种感觉了，Chika！为什么偏偏是{i}他{/i}？为什么我非得去争？！
: Rin——

lines.en: : I don’t even have a {i}phone{/i} now! And Sensei’s definitely going to find out about this one way or another, so {i}that’s{/i} going to be a thing I need to figure out how to deal with.
lines.zh: : 我现在连{i}手机{/i}都没有了！而且 Sensei 迟早一定会知道这件事，所以我还得想好怎么面对。

lines.en: : Which isn’t even mentioning how my {i}other{/i} mom is going to learn! And I can only imagine how {i}that{/i} is going to go since {i}she’s{/i} the strict one!
lines.zh: : 更别提我{i}另一位{/i}妈妈会怎么知道了！而{i}她{/i}才是严格的那个，我简直不敢想象{i}那{/i}会是什么场面！
: Rin——

lines.en: : I’m just fucking exploding inside and I don’t know how to handle it! I’m used to feeling {i}nothing,{/i} not this! I hate it! I fucking hate it, Chika! For once in my life, I {i}want{/i} to feel numb! But this just keeps growing it-
lines.zh: : 我整个人就他妈在里面炸开了，我不知道该怎么处理！我以前习惯的是{i}什么都感觉不到{/i}，而不是这样！我恨！我他妈恨死这种感觉了，Chika！这辈子我就{i}想{/i}麻木一次！可它偏偏还在不停地长大——
: Rin。
: 什么？！我还没发泄完呢！
: 躺下。

lines.en: : Huh? Why? You might not hate me right now, but I’m still not going to let you cuddle with a girl who would have fucked your boyfriend if he came here tonight.
lines.zh: : 哈？为什么？就算你现在不恨我，我也不会让你去抱着一个「要是他今晚来了就会上了你男朋友」的女孩。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I wasn’t planning on cuddling in the first place.
lines.zh: : 没关系。反正我一开始也没打算抱你。
: 那你要——
: 呃呃呃呃呃呃你到底在干什——么？？？
: 你爱我，对吧？
: 那就相信我，好吗？

lines.en: : Trust you with {i}what?!{/i} What do you-
lines.zh: : 相信你{i}什么？！{/i}你到底——

lines.en: : Your shirt’s in the way. I’m gonna move it.
lines.zh: : 你的衣服碍事了。我要把它掀开。
: 你要干什么？！

lines.en: : {i}Ah!{/i} Oh my God...Chika! Hold on! I’m confused!
lines.zh: : {i}啊！{/i}我的天……Chika！等等！我好混乱！
: 混乱什么？……

lines.en: : {i}This!{/i} You’re with Sensei! We’re just friends! My brain! Ah! Hold on! Stop!
lines.zh: : {i}这个啊！{/i}你跟 Sensei 在一起！我们只是朋友！我的脑子！啊！等等！停下！
: 你起鸡皮疙瘩了。

lines.en: : Of course I have goosebumps! Who {i}wouldn’t{/i} have goosebumps right now?! But this is-
lines.zh: : 我当然起鸡皮疙瘩了！谁这会儿{i}不{/i}起鸡皮疙瘩啊？！可这也太——

lines.en: : This is me taking care of you...
lines.zh: : 这是我照顾你的方式……

lines.en: : Y-Y-You don’t have to! You shouldn’t! You should punish me! I fucked up!
lines.zh: : 不、不、不用这样！你不该这样！你该惩罚我！是我搞砸了！

lines.en: : Okaaaaaay, then think of it as me punishing you instead. Does that work?
lines.zh: : 好——吧，那你就当成我在惩罚你好了。这样行吗？

lines.en: : No! None of this works! Have you lost your-
lines.zh: : 不行！哪样都不行！你是不是疯——
: 啊嗯~

lines.en: : Ooooooh my god! This can’t be happeniiiiiiing!
lines.zh: : 哦——我的天！这不可能正在发——生——！

lines.en: : Like a dream come true, right?
lines.zh: : 像美梦成真一样，对吧？
: Chika……说真的……

lines.en: : Bear with me, okay? I’ve never done this before.
lines.zh: : 忍一下，好吗？我从没做过这个。
: Chika——
: 啊啊！
